name: Ishmael (son of Jehohanan)
title: Military commander who assisted Jehoiada
summary: Ishmael, son of Jehohanan, was one of the military commanders who made a covenant with the priest Jehoiada to install King Joash and overthrow Queen Athaliah.

keyEvents.title: Assisting Jehoiada in installing Joash
keyEvents.description: Ishmael, son of Jehohanan, was among the military commanders who made a covenant with Jehoiada to make Joash king.
